'''Venky’s (India) Limited''' (often styled '''Venky’s''') is an Indian publicly listed poultry company based in [[Pune]], [[Maharashtra]]. It is part of the [[V H Group|Venkateshwara Hatcheries (VH) Group]]. Its business activities include breeding, hatcheries, feed, specific-pathogen-free (SPF) eggs, processed chicken, animal health products, and oilseed processing. The company traces its incorporation to 1976, and was formerly known as Western Hatcheries Limited.<ref name="venkys">{{Cite web|title=Venky's (India) Limited – About Us|url=https://www.venkys.com/about-us/|website=Venkys.com|access-date=4 September 2025}}</ref>

==History==
Venky’s India Limited was incorporated in 1976 and later adopted its current name after operating as Western Hatcheries Limited; the change of name took effect in June 2000.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Venky's (India) Limited – Company Info |url=https://www.zaubacorp.com/VENKY-S-INDIA-LIMITED-L01222PN1976PLC017422 |website=ZaubaCorp |access-date=4 September 2025}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |title=Venky's (India) Limited – History |url=https://www.goodreturns.in/company/venky-s-india/history.html |website=Goodreturns.in |access-date=4 September 2025}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |title=Venky's (India) Limited – Background Information |url=https://capitalmarket.com/Markets/CompanyInformation/backgroundinfo/venkys-%28india%29-ltd/1250 |website=Capital Market |access-date=4 September 2025}}</ref>

Venky’s is part of the wider [[V H Group]], founded in 1971 by [[B. V. Rao|Banda Vasudev Rao]].<ref>{{Cite web |title=Group Profile – VH Group |url=https://venkys.com/group-profile/ |website=Venkys.com |access-date=4 September 2025}}</ref>

==Operations==
Venky’s operates through three principal segments: [[Poultry]] and Poultry Products, Animal Health Products, and Oilseed. Offerings include day-old broiler and layer chicks, specific-pathogen-free (SPF) eggs, processed chicken products, poultry feeds and supplements, as well as soy extraction and refined edible oil.<ref>{{Cite web|title=Venky's (India) Limited – Company Profile|url=https://www.reuters.com/markets/companies/VENK.NS/|website=Reuters|access-date=4 September 2025}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|title=Business Responsibility and Sustainability Report (Mar 2024)|url=https://nsearchives.nseindia.com/corporate/VENKEYS_19082024105631_VIL_BRSR_Mar24.pdf|website=NSE India Archives|access-date=4 September 2025}}</ref>

===Retail and foodservice===
[[File:Venky's Xprs.jpg|thumb|A Venky’s Xprss quick-service outlet in [[India]]]]

Under the Venky’s brand, the group has developed a small chain of quick-service outlets (often styled '''Venky’s Xprs'''/'''XPRSS''') focused on processed chicken. A 2024 credit report noted “around 14 express outlets” operated under Venky’s at the time.<ref>{{Cite web|title=CARE Ratings Press Release: Venky's (India) Limited|url=https://www.careratings.com/upload/CompanyFiles/PR/202401140144_Venkys_India_Limited.pdf|website=CARE Ratings|date=January 2024|access-date=4 September 2025}}</ref>

==Corporate affairs==
Venky’s is headquartered at Venkateshwara House on Sinhagad Road, [[Pune]], [[Maharashtra]].<ref>{{Cite web |title=Venky's (India) Limited – Company Profile |url=https://www.dnb.com/business-directory/company-profiles.venkys_%28india%29_limited.dcfc9267f8120cb1cc0188c7c7d73ca7.html |website=Dun & Bradstreet |access-date=4 September 2025}}</ref>

As of 2024, Venkateshwara Hatcheries Pvt. Ltd. (VHPL) of the VH Group held a controlling stake of about 51.02% in Venky’s (India) Limited.<ref>{{Cite web |title=CARE Ratings Press Release: Venky's (India) Limited |url=https://www.careratings.com/upload/CompanyFiles/PR/202401140144_Venkys_India_Limited.pdf |website=CARE Ratings |date=January 2024 |access-date=4 September 2025}}</ref>

==Relationship to VH Group and sports==
[[File:rovers jersey.jpg|thumb|[[Blackburn Rovers F.C.]] shirt displaying Venky’s branding]]

In November 2010, the [[V H Group]] purchased English football club [[Blackburn Rovers F.C.]], the first Indian ownership of a [[Premier League]] club. Reports at the time valued the transaction at approximately £23–54 million including debt assumption.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Venky's announce acquisition of EPL club Blackburn Rovers |url=https://www.business-standard.com/article/companies/venky-s-announce-acquisition-of-epl-club-blackburn-rovers-110112000137_1.html |website=Business Standard |date=20 November 2010 |access-date=4 September 2025}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |title=Blackburn deal worth 54 million pounds: Indian owners |url=https://www.reuters.com/article/sports/blackburn-deal-worth-54-million-pounds-indian-owners-idUSTRE6AJ0YQ/ |website=Reuters |date=19 November 2010 |access-date=4 September 2025}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |title=Venky's acquires Blackburn Rovers |url=https://www.medianama.com/2010/11/223-venkys-blackburn-rovers-2/ |website=Medianama |date=19 November 2010 |access-date=4 September 2025}}</ref>

In July 2023, [[Blackburn Rovers F.C.]] announced a five-year sponsorship agreement with the VH Group that placed the Venky’s brand on the men’s and women’s playing kits, as well as other club assets.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Rovers strike sponsorship deal with Ownership VH Group |url=https://www.rovers.co.uk/news/2023/july/19/rovers-strike-sponsorship-deal-with-ownership-vh-group/ |website=rovers.co.uk |date=19 July 2023 |access-date=4 September 2025}}</ref>
